item.title: Aloe Agriculture Technologies thrives in Kunene …farmer Swanepoel defies the odds
item.description: SESFONTEIN– Located in Namibia’s dry and scorching-hot Kunene region, Aloe Agriculture Technologies, established in 1993, is thriving and showing that farming can flourish even in tough conditions. Veteran farmer and farm manager Johannes Swanepoel oversees Farm Warmquelle, where they grow sweet corn, butternuts, tomatoes, and green peppers. Their produce is primarily supplied to major retailers...
